headline: B200 edges up +1% on neocloud strength while H200 and L40S indexes hold flat over seven days.
bullets: B200's market index rose +1% to $8.60 over 7 days, led by neocloud +6% and marketplace +3% while hyperscaler pricing held at +0%.
H200's index was unchanged at $5.40 (+0%), but its marketplace median climbed +6% to $4.33, with RunPod Community Cloud cheapest at $3.59.
L40S's index was +0% at $1.50 despite a +5% marketplace move to $0.77, while the A100 80GB SXM marketplace median slipped -2% to $1.28.
Across all 11 tracked GPUs, H100 PCIe offers the best price-performance at $3.60 per PFLOP-hour, with MI300X close behind at $3.62.
H100 NVL carries the widest hyperscaler premium at +184%; among headline GPUs, H100 SXM stands at +140%, with a hyperscaler median of $10.68 versus a neocloud median of $4.45.
watch: Watch whether B200's +6% neocloud move spreads into hyperscaler pricing, which held at +0% this week.
